m4a1.assets-notes: Free CC0 Guns and Explosives Pack by 3dmodelscc0, https://3dmodelscc0.itch.io/free-cc0-guns-explosives-pack, CC0 (tagged CC0 and Public Domain on the page). Converted FBX to GLB (FBX2glTF), 1024px JPEG maps, normal map green flipped for glTF.

ak47.assets-notes: Classic Weapons Pack by Stein Games, https://stein-indie.itch.io/classic-weapons-pack, CC0 (licence stated on the page and in the zip). Converted FBX to GLB (FBX2glTF), skin and bullet meshes stripped, 1024px JPEG base colour, normal and ORM maps.

flat.assets-notes: Flat Guns West by Pichuliru, https://opengameart.org/content/cc0-flat-guns-west, CC0, low-poly, own materials (previous default, kept as an alternate).

lab.assets-notes: M4A1 by 3dmodelscc0 (Free CC0 Guns and Explosives Pack, https://3dmodelscc0.itch.io/free-cc0-guns-explosives-pack), CC0. 2K webp maps (colour, normal, ORM) from the Photoreal Lab, applied from the `maps` files; see docs/assets.md.
